instruction: Use the Autodesk Fusion 360 GUI in the Manufacture workspace. Open the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\plate_100x60x12.step. Create a 3-axis milling setup in Fusion 360 Manufacture for the plate. Set the WCS origin at the stock top-face center, expand stock 2 mm on X/Y sides and 1 mm above the part, and face the top surface to Z=12.000 mm. Tool definition: T1 is a 16 mm face mill for facing, S6000 rpm, F800 mm/min. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-1.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
source: Fusion Setup 与 NC Program 文档。(Autodesk) https://www.autodesk.com/learn/ondemand/tutorial/create-a-setup-in-fusion-for-milling?utm_source=chatgpt.com
